subject: math
question:
设 $\int f(x) \, \mathrm{d}x = F(x) + C$ ， $f(x)$ 可微，且 $f(x)$ 的反函数 $f^{-1}(x)$ 存在，证明：

$$
\int f ^ {- 1} (x) \mathrm{d} x = x f ^ {- 1} (x) - F [ f ^ {- 1} (x) ] + C.
$$
answer: \begin{array}{r l} \int f ^ {- 1} (x) \mathrm{d} x & = \int y \mathrm{d} f (y) = y f (y) - \int f (y) \mathrm{d} y \\ & = y f (y) - F (y) + C = x f ^ {- 1} (x) - F \left(f ^ {- 1} (x)\right) + C. \end{array}

steps.text: 分析 由于已知 $f(x)$ 的原函数，所以只需作变量代换 $x = f(y)$ ，就可将被积函数转化为 $f(y)$ 的形式.

solution.final_answer: \begin{array}{r l} \int f ^ {- 1} (x) \mathrm{d} x & = \int y \mathrm{d} f (y) = y f (y) - \int f (y) \mathrm{d} y \\ & = y f (y) - F (y) + C = x f ^ {- 1} (x) - F \left(f ^ {- 1} (x)\right) + C. \end{array}
